about: A bot's name in a message is a link to its chat, on the web page (botNameLinks in public/app.js) and in the Android app (BotNames in android/shared).

cases: { name, bots, text, links, endings? }. bots: [{ id, name }], the bots that exist. links: the names found in text, in order, as [where it starts, its text, the bot's id]. endings: the name endings the case reads, where it gives them; else Polish's.

The text of a link is the name as written, plus one of the endings Polish gives it (owi ami ach em om ów ie ze a u y i e ę ą); case as the name has it; a whole word; the longest name first; a name two bots share, a name of one letter and a name after @, / or - are not links. A letter or number of Chinese, Japanese or Korean beside a name is no longer word: a name stands between them (no spaces between words there); a Latin one is. An ending written in Chinese, Japanese or Korean letters (a particle: は, が, 의) is never part of a link: the particle stays outside it.
